The runner box strip fix is already implemented per the plan. Changes: `NowPlayingBar.jsx` now renders all runner boxes in a horizontally scrollable `overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden` strip (`now-playing-runner-strip`, `tabIndex=0`, `aria-describedby` scroll hint, `RUNNER_STRIP_SCROLL_HINT`) with removed `MAX_VISIBLE_RUNNER_BOXES` cap and `+N more` overflow chip; `index.css` adds thin themed scrollbar, `overscroll-behavior-x: contain`, `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` and `scroll-padding-inline`. Tests in `NowPlayingBar.test.jsx` were rewritten to verify 6 runners all render, scrollable keyboard-focusable region, and controls on boxes past the old cap. Verification: `test:frontend` 3866/3866 passed, `test:unit` passed, lint clean (warnings only), frontend build built.
